## Creating XGBoost Model
```{r}

# Load Data
df <- read.csv("hyrox_results_updated_V4.csv")

# Filter Completed Athletes & Add Percentile
df_completed <- df %>%
  filter(tolower(completed) == "yes") %>%
  mutate(
    percentile = ecdf(total_time)(total_time) * 100,
    gender = as.factor(gender),
    nationality = as.factor(nationality),
    age_group = as.factor(age_group)
  )

# Define Predictors
predictors <- c(
  paste0("run_", 1:8),
  "ski_erg", "sled_push", "sled_pull", "burpee_broad_jumps",
  "rowing", "farmers_carry", "sandbag_lunges", "wall_balls",
  "gender", "nationality", "age_group"
)

df_model <- df_completed %>%
  select(all_of(predictors), percentile) %>%
  drop_na()

# Encode Categorical Variables
dummies <- dummyVars(~ gender + nationality + age_group, data = df_model)
df_dummies <- predict(dummies, df_model)

df_final <- df_model %>%
  select(run_1:wall_balls) %>%
  bind_cols(as.data.frame(df_dummies)) %>%
  mutate(percentile = df_model$percentile)

# Train-Test Split
set.seed(1234)
train_idx <- createDataPartition(df_final$percentile, p = 0.8, list = FALSE)
train_data <- df_final[train_idx, ]
test_data  <- df_final[-train_idx, ]

# Convert to Matrix
X_train <- as.matrix(train_data %>% select(-percentile))
y_train <- train_data$percentile
X_test  <- as.matrix(test_data %>% select(-percentile))
y_test  <- test_data$percentile

# Train XGBoost Regression Model
xgb_model <- xgboost(
  data = X_train,
  label = y_train,
  nrounds = 300,
  max_depth = 6,
  eta = 0.1,
  objective = "reg:squarederror",
  eval_metric = "rmse",
  verbose = 0
)

# Predictions on Test Data
test_data <- test_data %>%
  mutate(pred_percentile = predict(xgb_model, X_test))

# Accuracy Metrics
mean_error <- mean(test_data$percentile - test_data$pred_percentile)
mean_abs_error <- mean(abs(test_data$percentile - test_data$pred_percentile))
rmse <- sqrt(mean((test_data$percentile - test_data$pred_percentile)^2))
r2 <- cor(test_data$percentile, test_data$pred_percentile)^2
mape <- mean(abs((test_data$percentile - test_data$pred_percentile) / test_data$percentile)) * 100

cat("Mean Error:", mean_error, "\n")
cat("Mean Absolute Error:", mean_abs_error, "\n")
cat("RMSE:", rmse, "\n")
cat("R²:", r2, "\n")
cat("MAPE (%):", mape, "\n")

# Predicted vs Actual Plot
ggplot(test_data, aes(x = percentile, y = pred_percentile)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, color = "black") +
  labs(title = "Predicted vs Actual Percentile (XGBoost)",
       x = "Actual Percentile", y = "Predicted Percentile") +
  theme_minimal()

# Residual Plot
ggplot(test_data, aes(x = pred_percentile, y = percentile - pred_percentile)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "red") +
  labs(x = "Predicted Percentile", y = "Residuals",
       title = "Residual Plot (XGBoost)") +
  theme_minimal()

# Feature Importance
importance <- xgb.importance(model = xgb_model)
xgb.plot.importance(importance_matrix = importance)

# Grouped Feature Importance (like Linear Model)
importance_df <- importance %>%
  mutate(
    FeatureGroup = case_when(
      grepl("gender", Feature) ~ "gender",
      grepl("nationality", Feature) ~ "nationality",
      grepl("age_group", Feature) ~ "age_group",
      TRUE ~ Feature
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(FeatureGroup) %>%
  summarise(importance = mean(Gain), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(desc(importance))

ggplot(importance_df, aes(x = reorder(FeatureGroup, importance), y = importance)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", fill = "steelblue") +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(title = "Grouped Feature Importance (XGBoost Gain)",
       x = "Feature", y = "Mean Gain") +
  theme_minimal()

# Predict Percentile for a New Athlete
new_athlete <- data.frame(
  run_1 = 250, run_2 = 270, run_3 = 260, run_4 = 280,
  run_5 = 270, run_6 = 265, run_7 = 275, run_8 = 260,
  ski_erg = 200, sled_push = 350, sled_pull = 340,
  burpee_broad_jumps = 300, rowing = 250, farmers_carry = 220,
  sandbag_lunges = 280, wall_balls = 260,
  gender = "male", nationality = "Ireland", age_group = "30-34"
)

# Match factor levels
new_athlete$gender <- factor(new_athlete$gender, levels = levels(df_model$gender))
new_athlete$nationality <- factor(new_athlete$nationality, levels = levels(df_model$nationality))
new_athlete$age_group <- factor(new_athlete$age_group, levels = levels(df_model$age_group))

# Encode new athlete
new_dummy <- predict(dummies, new_athlete)
new_input <- as.matrix(bind_cols(new_athlete %>% select(run_1:wall_balls), as.data.frame(new_dummy)))

pred_percentile_new <- predict(xgb_model, new_input)
cat("Predicted Percentile for New Athlete:", round(pred_percentile_new, 2), "%\n")
```
